summary: 16 selected items center on the GPT-6 Astra launch and its reception. The core launch is covered from distinct angles (OpenAI product announcement, OpenAI benchmarks, Altman's framing, and Artificial Analysis independent cost/efficiency analysis), supported by practitioner stories, architecture-rumor analysis, policy remarks, and unrelated items (Nvidia/Hugging Face, Martian routing, IFM open models, Zuckerberg regulator stance). Same-topic clusters are flagged for editorial awareness. mattshumer_ and andrewho03 each contribute two items; andrewho03's two posts are closely related practitioner reflections and are flagged as overrepresented_author. All items are self-contained per their context notes; no special-account reply lacks a successful context summary. Selection count (16) is at the top of the 9-16 target, so no replacements are required.
